curated.text: The RL-Kernel project has just been open sourced on GitHub. RL-Kernel is a low level kernel library designed for RLHF training of LLMs, with a particular focus on algorithms such as GRPO and PPO. It is deeply integrated with FlashInfer, with future plans to support CUTLASS and FlyDSL. The project includes custom implementations of sampling, prefix shared attention, TMA, and other performance critical kernels. According to the authors, some high frequency training components achieve up to 163× speedups while also reducing memory usage. The team is currently looking for collaborators with access
